description.en: Replaces the status-bar output speed with two figures, e.g. 207(122) tok/s: outside the parentheses the decoding speed after the first token, inside it the speed over the whole request including first-token latency. Clicking the item opens a breakdown with turns, steps, TTFT and per-phase timings; DSH's own figure returns when the plugin is not loaded.
description.zh: 把底栏输出速度改成双口径，如 `207(122) tok/s`：括号外是首字之后的解码速度，括号内是含首字延迟的整段速度。点一下弹出轮次、步数、首字延迟与各阶段用时明细；插件未载入时仍显示 DSH 自带那颗。
